newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores, C.R. Anthony in discussions.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores, C.R. Anthony in discussions.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc and C.R. Anthony Co said Wednesday they were in discussions about a possible combination of the companies.
They did not specify the nature of the potential combination and said there was no assurance an agreemnt could be reached.
"We are in similar lines of business and serve similar markets," said C.R. Anthony Vice Chairman Michael McCreery. He declined further comment.
Officilas from Stage Stores were not available for comment.
The companies operate specialty retail and department stores in the central and western U.S.
